string.text: Left some supplies in case I bail from Zaton.
Tossed my piece and a couple of ammo packs up a tree, gotta check later if they didn't fall down.
We shook down some stalkers, and I've got more of these pistol slugs than I know what to do with, for real. Left the extra under the pontoon, will grab it later.
Ah damn, long story short, I'll leave my AK here for now, hope nobody snatches it.
Stumbled upon some good army medkits and some science junk, leaving it here for now.
Stashed some extra loot under a rock where we made camp, we'll grab it later.
Hid some loot here in a tree, near our spot. Not sure where our boss is heading yet.
Stashed some meds here, place seems quiet and deserted, will pick it up later.
I'll leave it here on the roof, for now I'll head back to base in my jacket.
Buried a real sweet gun here, ammo for it and a couple of nades, will pick it up when I come back with the boys.
Dropped a AK and a little surprise for you, better grab it before it all rusts.
Gonna dump the extra expensive ammo in this truck bed. It's hot as hell here, and the place is crap, near an anomaly. Doubt anyone will crawl in here.
Left it under the table for a rainy day, it'll come in handy.
Found someone's stash under the bushes, marked it on my PDA for now, but can't grab it.
Landmarks are crap, but I think you'll figure it out. Stashed a GP-25 and some VOG rounds there, grab it and let's get to work.
Me and the boys dumped a piece we took from some sucker here, but it's no good for us, just worthless crap.
Bought a real cool piece, but don't wanna flash it to the boys, let it lie here.
Stashed some meds by the tree. Will come in handy when I head towards the Iron Forest.
No shit, I was walking and found some killer's piece. Tossed it in a truck bed with a couple of ammo packs for it.
The boss said we don't need them for the job yet, so I decided to stash mine here in a car nearby.
Took a bunch of loot from the heli in the swamps. Dumped the meds and some weird pills in a pipe nearby, will figure it out later.
Put some of the loot I cleaned out from the heli near a tree. VOGs here, hope they don't detonate out in the open, will grab them later.
Got lightly wounded after the hunt, can't carry it, will hide it here in the roots for now.
Spotted a weird symbol on the wall and, seems like there's loot in the electrical box, but I can't get to it nohow, just marking it on the PDA.
Passing on the stash coordinates, use it as you see fit.
Hey, you gonna pick up our Boozer's piece soon? If you don't manage by tomorrow, I'll personally shove that gun up your ass.
Spotted some loot from the street, but I ain't going for it, this place feels wrong and I got a feeling I'm not alone here.
Left the VSS on the farmhouse roof after the job, just marking it on my PDA for now.
Dumped some extra loot, 'cause I feel like I'm gonna throw my back out soon, and I've got a long trek to Skadovsk ahead.
Dropped some powerful loot here, the spot's good, doubt anyone will find it.
Tossed my old Kalash on the roof, doubt anyone would think to climb up here.
I'll leave it here, looks quiet and reliable, need to fence it to a trader in a couple of days.
Dammit, left my guns in this cursed Lada, and it started glowing after the blowout, what a mess.
It's quiet here, I'll drop some loot and move on towards Yanov.
Tossed it behind the rocks, worked out pretty convenient, will grab it later.
Hid some loot under the concrete bridge, what we had on us. Our guys will pick it up later.
There should be some gun on top of the diesel locomotive. Don't know what kind, didn't check, heard it by chance when drunk.
Picked up a dead Duty member's PDA, there's a stash on it. Don't know what's in it, don't even wanna go near the plant outskirts, that place is death.
Near the science bunker in the swamp, I'll grab it when I'm ready.
Dropped a good shotgun here, if anyone steals it - I'll find them and break all their teeth.
Dropped some essentials here to prepare for the run towards the plant.
Couldn't resist, snitched some loot from the boys and stuffed it in the ZIL cab.
Yar said not to chicken out from the local zombies, we can stash loot right here, they'll scare off the local jacket trash like scarecrows.
In the excavator cab, watch your step. Take the readings and get back to the bunker.
Mission accomplished, dumping ammo, meet at the rendezvous point. Over and out.
The Lieutenant ordered us to stash a backup gun somewhere in this grid, in case we clash with the bandits.
Dumped everything I managed to carry out under a fir tree near the warehouse, now we gotta get the hell out of here ASAP.
Snatched it for a good price, hid it near the Cops, safer that way. Can test it on the locals too.
Spotted a gun, but was too scared to go for it, the detectors are going crazy in this spot.
Need to grab this stash before dark, when you're done with your business, head to the Cops, I've sent the marker to your PDA.
Bought a newer gun, so I don't need this one anymore, but I can't bring myself to sell it. Let it lie here with ammo for a rainy day.
First signal registered by the UAV when it flew over the area.
Second signal registered by the UAV when it flew over the area.
Third signal registered by the UAV when it flew over the area.
